parameters.description: Preserve exact elevated 4:3 diamond footprint and thin sides. Broad clean pixel clusters, 85% empty surface, two restrained green tones. No scattered pixels, tiny flecks, checkerboard dithering, stones or cracks. Clean flat top, transparent outside tile, no cast shadow.
